stories.title: Raptors’ Leonard out at least another week
stories.summary: The Toronto Raptors will be without forward Kawhi Leonard for at least another week as he deals with swelling in his left knee, the NBA club said Tuesday.

stories.title: Ford defends Chow, Del Duca using strong powers as critics raise alarms
stories.summary: While Premier Doug Ford is lauding the use of strong powers, critics are concerned wielding newly expanded authority ends up circumventing democratic processes.

stories.title: Ontario vows to restore frozen OSAP by New Year if fraud bill passes
stories.summary: The Ford government is under mounting criticism for freezing OSAP funding, a pause that began in early October, for students at all 242 Ontario private career colleges.

stories.title: Transport minister defends new land seizure powers proposed for high-speed rail
stories.summary: Transport Minister Steven MacKinnon is pushing back against criticism of new land seizure powers proposed for a high-speed rail project between Toronto and Quebec City.

stories.title: Ontario property tax change could hike affordable housing costs: critics
stories.summary: The proposed changes would amend Ontario's Assessment Act to block charitable housing providers from getting a property tax exemption in 2027.

stories.title: Mortgage delinquency rate up 31% in Q3, driven by Ontario and B.C.: Equifax report
stories.summary: A new report suggests there's growing stress among homeowners, with some struggling to keep up with monthly mortgage payments as interest rates rise again.

stories.title: Raptors again searching for answers
stories.summary: Jamal Shead was at a loss to explain another disappointing showing by the Toronto Raptors.

stories.title: Ullmark looks past great numbers to improve
stories.summary: Linus Ullmark is off to an impressive start this season, but the Ottawa Senators goaltender often remains his harshest critic.

stories.title: Ullmark leads Senators to 2-1 win over Flames
stories.summary: Linus Ullmark continued his impressive start to the season on Monday, making 34 saves to lead the Ottawa Senators to a 2-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: Herro’s 32 powers Bucks past Raptors 116-111
stories.summary: Tyler Herro scored 32 points, including 15 in the third quarter, as the Milwaukee Bucks powered past the Toronto Raptors 116-111 on Monday to snap a 13-game losing skid.
